mapper.update: UPDATE user_saved_routes SET title = #{route.title}, note = #{route.note}, url = #{route.url}, selected_variant = #{route.selectedVariant}, selected_recipe_key = #{route.selectedRecipeKey}, max_depth = #{route.maxDepth}, snapshot_json = #{route.snapshotJson}, deleted = 0, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{route.id} AND user_id = #{route.userId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_saved_routes usr INNER JOIN items i ON usr.target_type = 'CRAFTING_ITEM' AND i.id = usr.target_id AND i.deleted = 0 AND (i.status IS NULL OR i.status = 1) WHERE usr.user_id = #{userId} AND usr.target_type = 'CRAFTING_ITEM' AND usr.deleted = 0

SELECT usr.id AS id, usr.target_type AS targetType, usr.target_id AS targetId, COALESCE(NULLIF(usr.title, ''), NULLIF(i.name_zh, ''), i.name, i.internal_name) AS title, ( SELECT ii.cached_url FROM item_images ii WHERE ii.item_id = i.id AND ii.deleted = 0 AND ii.status = 1 AND NULLIF(TRIM(ii.cached_url), '') IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(TRIM(ii.cached_url)) LIKE '%/terrapedia-images/%' ORDER BY CASE WHEN ii.is_primary = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, ii.sort_order ASC, ii.id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS imageUrl, usr.route_mode AS routeMode, usr.selected_variant AS selectedVariant, usr.selected_recipe_key AS selectedRecipeKey, usr.max_depth AS maxDepth, usr.note AS note, usr.url AS url, CAST(usr.snapshot_json AS CHAR) AS snapshotJson, usr.created_at AS createdAt, usr.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM user_saved_routes usr INNER JOIN items i ON usr.target_type = 'CRAFTING_ITEM' AND i.id = usr.target_id AND i.deleted = 0 AND (i.status IS NULL OR i.status = 1) WHERE usr.user_id = #{userId} AND usr.target_type = 'CRAFTING_ITEM' AND usr.deleted = 0 ORDER BY usr.updated_at DESC, usr.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.sql: SELECT usr.id AS id, usr.target_type AS targetType, usr.target_id AS targetId, COALESCE(NULLIF(usr.title, ''), NULLIF(i.name_zh, ''), i.name, i.internal_name) AS title, NULL AS imageUrl, usr.route_mode AS routeMode, usr.selected_variant AS selectedVariant, usr.selected_recipe_key AS selectedRecipeKey, usr.max_depth AS maxDepth, usr.note AS note, usr.url AS url, CAST(usr.snapshot_json AS CHAR) AS snapshotJson, usr.created_at AS createdAt, usr.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM user_saved_routes usr INNER JOIN items i ON usr.target_type = 'CRAFTING_ITEM' AND i.id = usr.target_id AND i.deleted = 0 AND (i.status IS NULL OR i.status = 1) WHERE usr.user_id = #{userId} AND usr.id = #{id} AND usr.target_type = 'CRAFTING_ITEM' AND usr.deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
